# FlareEditorBreadcrumbBar

`Flare.Components.IDE.FlareEditorBreadcrumbBar`

The editor breadcrumb/toolbar row shown under the document tabs: a theme-sized strip with a leading breadcrumb slot and a trailing action area. The host supplies the segments and commands; the row owns only the chrome. Use FlareEditorBreadcrumbSegment items for the breadcrumb path, and any Flare controls for the actions.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ActionsLabel` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Accessible name of the trailing action area. Null uses the package's localized "Editor actions" text. |
| `BreadcrumbContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Leading content of the row - typically one or more FlareEditorBreadcrumbSegment items. The host supplies the path; the row adds no items of its own. |
| `ToolbarContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Trailing action area of the row - the host's editor commands, an error count or a split/layout control. Rendered in a labelled toolbar; the row adds no commands. |
